close_reason: All seven coding-pack stories are implemented. Focused Jidoka and CLI verification passed: 66 Jidoka tests and 46 CLI phase tests.
description:
# Phase outcome

Default coding pack. Entry: built-in host and constrained execution. Exit: removable read, search, write, edit, shell, Git, verification, project context, and review form one safe default coding path.

# Ranked child stories

1. `jido_cli-tqg.5.1` — Define the removable coding pack and workspace boundary (P1)
2. `jido_cli-tqg.5.2` — Add removable read and search coding tools (P1)
3. `jido_cli-tqg.5.3` — Add reviewed write and exact-edit coding tools (P1)
4. `jido_cli-tqg.5.4` — Add a bounded constrained shell tool (P1)
5. `jido_cli-tqg.5.5` — Add Git review tools and named verification helpers (P2)
6. `jido_cli-tqg.5.6` — Make the default coding setup selectable and context-aware (P2)
7. `jido_cli-tqg.5.7` — Show edit records and bounded diffs in the TUI (P2)

# Status rule

All child stories remain open. Story dependency links, not priority alone, control implementation order.
title: Phase 4: Ship a removable default coding pack
